text: Sumitt is AI-powered summarization software that summarizes long documents, such as scholarly journals, articles, and book chapters.
Fatima Manzoor is the creator of the Sumitt project.
The funding for the Sumitt project was canceled by the project creator on February 21, 2022.
The funding goal for the Sumitt project was $21,184.
The Sumitt project was backed by 6 individuals.
The funding period for the Sumitt project was from February 11, 2022, to March 13, 2022.
The Sumitt software aims to help students who feel overwhelmed by the number of readings they have to do.
Beta testing surveys indicated that students who used Sumitt's assistance decreased their reading time by 70%.
Sumitt generates a shorter and simpler version of any document without compromising the quality of comprehension for the user.
The Sumitt project is based in Toronto, Canada.
Sumitt is a tool that generates a shorter and simpler version of any document without compromising comprehension.
Students who used Sumitt's assistance decreased their reading time by 70% and in some cases increased their comprehension.
Sumitt's novel algorithm extracts important parts of any document and presents it in a simpler format.
The algorithm shortens sentences, uses smaller fragments, and employs better words.
Sumitt uses a combination of AI and machine learning techniques to achieve reliable and quick outcomes.
The project faces challenges in maintaining enough funds to develop and test the software.
